title: Animal Sciences - Animal Science, Technology, and Production Option
sourceText:
ANIM SCI 101

ANIM SCI 180

CHEM 101 [PSCI] or 105 [PSCI]

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

MATH Requirement
MATH requirement may be satisfied by completing MATH 106 and 108, 140 [QUAN], 171 [QUAN], or 202 [QUAN].

BIOLOGY 106 [BSCI]

CHEM 102 or 106

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

H D 205 [COMM] (recommended) or COM 102 [COMM]

BIOLOGY 107

Lab Management Requirement
Lab Management Requirement courses (One course) include ANIM SCI 166, 172, 174 (Fall-only), 178, 280 (Spring only).

UCORE Inquiry
Must complete 3 of these 4 UCORE designations:  ARTS, DIVR, EQJS, HUM.

MATH Requirement and /or Electives
MATH requirement may be satisfied by completing MATH 106 and 108, 140 [QUAN], 171 [QUAN], or 202 [QUAN].

ANIM SCI 240

ECONS 101 [SSCI], ECONS 102 [SSCI], or ECONS 198

STAT 212 [QUAN], 412, or PSYCH 311 [QUAN]
Students who have not yet completed a [QUAN] course should select STAT 212 or PSYCH 311.

Electives

Complete Writing Portfolio

ANIM SCI 313

ANIM SCI 330

ANIM SCI 380

ANIM SCI Group 1 Elective
ANIM SCI Group 1 Electives (Two courses) include ANIM SCI 205, 260, 266, 267, 274, 285, 314, 345, 346, 360, and other courses as approved by advisor.

Business and Economics Course
Business and Economics Electives (Two courses) include ACCTG 230; B LAW 210; ECONS 330, 335, 350, 351, 352, 450, and other courses as approved by advisor.

ANIM SCI 350

ANIM SCI 351

VET CLIN 361, 367, or VET PH 308

Ag Sciences Elective
Ag Sciences Electives: Any level AFS, AGTM, CROP SCI, ENTOM, FS, HORT, SOE, and SOIL SCI course. To meet University requirements for upper division coursework, students may need to select a 300-400 level course.

ANIM SCI 464 [CAPS] [M], 466 [CAPS] [M], 472 [CAPS] [M], or 474 [CAPS] [M]
ANIM SCI 474 [CAPS][M] may be taken as an alternative in Spring semester.

ANIM SCI Group 2 Electives
ANIM SCI Group 2 Electives (Four courses) must include one [M] course. Students may choose any of the following courses that have not been used to fulfill other requirements: ANIM SCI 314, 345, 346, 360, 378, 408 [M], 440 [M], 451 [M], 454, 460, 464 [CAPS] [M], 466 [CAPS] [M], 468 [M], 472 [CAPS] [M], 474 [CAPS] [M], 481, 485 [M], 488 [M], and other courses as approved by advisor.

Electives
Elective courses should include sufficient credits and 300-400-level coursework to meet the University requirement of 120 credits and 40 credits of upper-division coursework.

Honors students complete the Honors College requirements, which replace the UCORE requirements. 

Newly matriculated students may be admitted to the animal sciences major upon making their intention known to the department.

Current students seeking admission to the major must have a cumulative GPA of 2.0 or better and be in good academic standing with the University.
